Crowley's Yacht Yard · Boat Location Map

3434 E. 95th St, Chicago · demo data · build 112526.2153
Settings
Transform connection
Reads the boat records from your Transform form and shows them in place of the demo boats. Browsers can't call Transform directly, so the dashboard goes through a proxy. With the Google Apps Script proxy, the Transform key stays in the script and this browser keeps only the proxy token. A Cloudflare proxy needs the key here instead, and has to allow GetFormInstancesArrayForFormId. If the connection is off or fails, the demo boats show.
Map
Areas and rows
Every area has a number that never changes, so boats and their history stay linked when you rename an area or change a yard's rows. Names marked ? are our guesses.
Satellite imagery
With a key, Satellite uses Google imagery; without one, or if Google refuses the key, it uses Esri World Imagery. The key stays in this browser only. The key's project needs the Map Tiles API turned on.
Sketch on the satellite
Solid fills in the yard ground and the storage areas, so boats that were parked there when the photo was taken don't show; roofs, roads, the rail and the river still do. See-through tints the areas and keeps the whole photo visible. Satellite only always shows the photo by itself. Saved in this browser.
Boat labels
Zoom in close on the sketch or the satellite and each boat shows a label on its hull. Tick any mix of name, ID and owner; with none ticked, no labels show. Saved in this browser.
Line up the layout with the photo
Building and storage positions are estimated. Nudge the whole layout until it sits on the real yard. Your setting is saved in this browser.
Service moves
For each department, and for any service under it: does the boat stay where it is for the work, or move to an area? A service set to Same as department follows its department; a service's own setting wins over its department's. When staff answer stays or moves in the form, that answer always wins. A move the setting expects but nobody recorded shows as a dashed outline and counts in Unconfirmed moves.
Department or serviceDefaultAreaAfter the job
Ask each time: a job with no stays-or-moves answer is flagged in Unconfirmed moves. Saved in this browser.
Voice
Narration voice
Uses the voices built into this browser, free and with no limits. The list shows the voices of the browser you are using, its best ones first: Natural voices in Edge, Google voices in Chrome, Enhanced or Premium voices in Safari. Your pick is saved for this browser. One voice reads every line of a boat's history; a new pick applies from the next Play history.
Gemini reads the Demo tour and the Play history voice-over with the key below. Each new line is one speech request billed to that key, and a line already made is reused while the page is open. If there is no key or Gemini doesn't answer, the browser voice takes over and a line on the page says so.
Gemini key (photos and Gemini voice)
The key stays in this browser only. It is used for the demo boat photos and the Gemini voice.
Photos
Boat photos made by Gemini
Uses the Gemini key above. Each new photo is one image request billed to that key. Photos are saved in this browser, so each one is made only once. These are made-up demo pictures, not photos of a real boat.
Location confirmedPosition estimatedBuilding outlines follow the straight-down map photo. What each building is used for is per the owner; shop bays and storage sections inside them are estimated.

YardAs of today, Nov 20. Schedules come from the inventory form; labor rates are made-up demo rates.
Boat ShopShop inventory: items, stock on hand, counter sales and parts pulled for work orders. Demo data, as the Boat Shop inventory records it.

Areas and rows
Every area has a number that never changes. Boats and their history are linked to the number, so you can rename freely.
Click an area on the map, or type over a name. Untick In use to retire an area; its number stays with its history and is never reused.
Set each yard's rows. New rows get new numbers, existing rows keep theirs, and rows left outside the range are retired unless boats are still in them. You see the changes before anything is applied.
South yard rows 2 to 13 are drawn on the sketch. Rows added here get their numbers right away and are listed as not on our map yet.
Download the list
Download the areas and the row setup as a spreadsheet, edit it in Excel or Google Sheets, and upload it again. Keep each ID as it is. Leave the ID blank on a new line to add an area.
Upload changes
CSV, XLSX or XLS. Nothing is deleted: areas missing from the file stay as they are. You see every change before anything is applied.
Start over
For this demo, names and rows are saved in this browser. In the live system the area list would be kept in Transform, so the form, the dashboard and every user share one list.
